why: Issue #690: nothing routed a throw during a running match to the player. Without the page's `error` listener a throw from input sampling, a sim step or a render escapes the frame to the window and nothing is shown -- the driver stops its loop, so the last pose simply freezes under a Main Menu-less screen. The exactly-once and already-handled cases still pass through the `unhandledrejection` half, so only the cases that dispatch an `error` or read its registration can see this.
killedBy: boot: an uncaught error during a running match (issue #690) stops the session and draws the match-failed overlay, reporting the error once
boot: an uncaught error during a running match (issue #690) reads the message when the error itself is missing, as for a cross-origin script error
